problem_statement: Build a brand-new Support Center page from scratch at the /support route of this Tokyo Free White MUI admin dashboard. The route does not exist yet — today it falls through to the 404 view. Construct the full page inside the site's existing dashboard shell (fixed left sidebar + top header + footer) and reuse the site's Material-UI design system (PageTitleWrapper + PageHeader title block, Card / CardHeader / Divider / CardContent, Tabs + Tab, Typography, the contained primary Button). The page must present a category tab group (Getting Started / Billing & Payments / Technical Issues) that actually drives the content: switching the tab must swap the visible category heading, its intro blurb and the list of FAQ question/answer pairs below it. It must also render without horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport.
required_content: A PageTitleWrapper header block with an h3 title 'Support Center' plus a subtitle line and a contained 'Contact support' button
A 'Browse help topics' Card (CardHeader + Divider + CardContent) that frames the whole help section
A category tab group with three tabs labelled 'Getting Started', 'Billing & Payments' and 'Technical Issues'
A prominent category heading (h3) that names the currently selected category, defaulting to 'Getting Started'
A short intro blurb under the heading plus a stack of at least three FAQ question/answer pairs for the selected category
Clicking a different category tab re-renders the category heading, the blurb and the FAQ list to that category's content
A closing 'Still need a hand?' Card and the shared site Footer, all inside the dashboard shell (left sidebar + top header)
design_constraints: Reuse the site's Material-UI components already used elsewhere (PageTitleWrapper, PageHeader pattern, Card/CardHeader/Divider/CardContent, Tabs/Tab, Typography, Button variant=contained)
Keep the Tokyo Free White palette, spacing and fonts; do not introduce a new visual language
Mount the page inside the existing SidebarLayout chrome (Sidebar + Header + Footer), consistent with the other pages

Match the Tokyo Free White palette exactly: primary/contained-button fill = #5569FF (rgb(85,105,255)) with white text, primary heading/body ink = #223354 (rgb(34,51,84)), muted/secondary text = rgb(110,117,159), page/section background = #F2F5F9 (rgb(242,245,249)), card surface = #FFFFFF; the desktop page mean luminance sits around 203 (predominantly white/light-grey surfaces).

Layout structure: PageTitleWrapper header row at top (h3 'Support Center' on the left, contained primary 'Contact support' button on the right), then a full-width 'Browse help topics' Card whose CardHeader sits above a Divider and CardContent; inside it the three category Tabs sit above the selected category's h3 heading + intro blurb + a vertical stack of >=3 FAQ question/answer pairs; a closing 'Still need a hand?' Card follows, all within the SidebarLayout shell.
author_notes: 方案A: baseline /support 是顶级空 route (element=<></>, 在 layout 壳外部), 不走 catch-all 重定向 404; reference 完整实现 category tab 切换 (选中 Billing 时 h3 变 'Billing & Payments'); bad 把 active topic 硬写为 topics[0] 使切换失灵 (tabs 渲染正常但点击不换内容)。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。route 无 basename (package.json 无 homepage 字段), state_plan path 为 /support。sidebar 有 'Error 404' 导航项, 故 forbidden_text_patterns 去掉裸 '404' (gotcha #18j)。
